subject.title: feat: expose readable session presentation metadata

question: Should `presentation.family` and `presentation.titleSource` be permanently frozen closed taxonomies, or forward-compatible values that older generated clients can accept when newer Gateways add classifications?
rationale: This is a durable public Gateway/native-client contract choice; tests can prove mechanics but cannot decide whether future classifications are forbidden or must decode tolerantly.

options.title: Use tolerant values
options.body: Represent the fields with extensible wire strings or generated unknown-value handling while documenting the currently recognized values.

options.title: Freeze both enums
options.body: Keep the closed enums only with an explicit contract that every future and plugin-owned case maps to existing fallback values.

options.title: Pause the contract
options.body: Keep the draft open until the cross-client versioning policy is settled if neither compatibility model is approved.

recommendation.title: Use tolerant values
recommendation.body: Represent the fields with extensible wire strings or generated unknown-value handling while documenting the currently recognized values.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work on the central session-list path and broader Gateway contract history make this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
